title: Luma Batch 3 — competitor coverage & evidence-integrity board (v2 — redesigned around loud absence and value×uncertainty)

findings.method: checked = 108 figures re-traced onto the v2 board, none re-derived from research/sources/ (not opened, per brief): 3 in the hero (6/14, 8, 2), 5 secondary KPIs, 11 in the F-01 disclaimer (5 stated + 5 recounted cell counts + the 275=55×5 identity), 14 row-state classifications in the fourteen-row table, 6 tier chips for the profiled six, 6 cells in the load-bearing-row spotlight, 10 cluster gap count-pairs (x of y Unknown — recomputed directly from ART-012's Unknown counts as Unknown/total, NOT by subtracting v1's already-rounded 'evidenced' percentages, to avoid compounding rounding: the ten results sum to 141/330 exactly, cross-checked against ART-011's own total), 48 journey-grid cells (value + confidence tag, transcribed verbatim from ART-012 § The journey comparison), and 5 designated-test scoreboard rows. found = 2, both load-bearing corrections to the v2 brief itself, both checked against primary sources rather than taken on trust: (1) Song & Szafir (IEEE VIS 2018) was fetched and read in full (not summarised from the brief's description) — the paper supports highlighting-over-removal as its least-qualified finding, but three of the brief's specific claims do not hold at the stated strength: alpha-blended 'gradient bars' scored HIGH on perceived quality in the paper's own bar-chart study (contradicting 'alpha-blending scores lower'), an annotation condition (disconnected/point error bars) scored BELOW the information-removal condition in 2 of the paper's 4 sub-studies (contradicting 'removal scored lowest of every condition'), and the 'measurably wrong answers' claim held in exactly 1 of 4 sub-studies (bar-graph averaging) with the paper's own discussion calling the mechanism a hypothesis needing future testing, not an established result; the paper also studies imputed points in continuous time series, not categorical table absence, and this board does not impute (D-001 forbids inventing a plausible value for a gap) — a domain mismatch the brief did not flag. All of this is recorded in the board's own Meta disclosure, not silently corrected. (2) The brief's assumed fallback resolution for the value×uncertainty matrix — 'if not 330 cells, build 10 clusters×6 competitors' — does not exist in ART-012 either: the cluster level carries only a single uncertainty scalar (Unknown-count) per cluster, with no per-competitor value dimension, so a 10×6 bivariate grid would require inventing 54 of 60 cells. The one place a complete per-cell value×uncertainty pair exists for every competitor is the 8-stage×6-competitor journey table (48 cells) and the single load-bearing row (6 cells) — both rendered with VSUP; the cluster chart is kept as what it honestly is, a single-axis gap-density view, explicitly labelled as not the bivariate. NOT DONE and not claimed: no figure was re-derived from research/sources/; no live competitor product was checked; no market-findings content was rendered (out of scope, stated on the board).

notes.why_a_new_id_and_not_ART-013_v2: Matches this repository's own established convention, not a reinterpretation of the brief: every prior version bump in this repo (ART-001→ART-002, ART-003→ART-004, ART-008→ART-009) mints a new sequential ART id for the new version and records the OLD id in supersedes, while inputs.artifacts cites the old version as an input. The brief's phrase 'rebuild ART-013 as v2' and its own instruction to name 'ART-013 v1' inside inputs.artifacts are consistent with this reading, not in tension with it.
notes.why_the_directory_still_says_v2: ADR-003's directory contract versions by slug, independent of the registry id — the same pattern as artifacts/design-system-selection/2026-08-26__prioritization__readiness-backlog__v2 (registry id ART-004, supersedes ART-003) sharing its v1's date and slug.
notes.what_survived_unchanged_from_v1: The KPI band (now split into one hero + five secondary metrics, each still carrying its own denominator and source section), the F-01 defect table (stated 275 vs recounted 330, side by side, unchanged numbers), and all 14 competitors present in ART-011's own order.
notes.what_changed_and_why: 1) The eight blank rows move from a faint diagonal hairline hatch on a mostly-light background (the 'downplay' condition) to a full-opacity warmGray.80 block, same footprint, same row position — the 'highlight' condition, on an achromatic hue so it still carries no verdict (D-001). 2) A three-state typed vocabulary replaces the prior two-state (profiled/not) framing: never-evaluated (scope decision, solid block), prior-art-only (D-002, same block + bold opaque stripe, not alpha-blended), and profiled (real chips, no gap styling at all — 'genuinely absent' cells like Google Travel's 'No, High' in the load-bearing row are rendered as ordinary present/absent chips, not as a gap, because a verified No is a finding, not blank). 3) The load-bearing row and the journey table are rendered with VSUP (Correll, Moritz & Heer, CHI 2018): value hue (teal, ordinal Strong>Adequate>Weak) is pulled toward a neutral grey at Medium confidence via CSS color-mix() of two already-validated tokens, so a weakly-evidenced rating cannot look as certain as a strongly-evidenced one. 4) Sections cut from 13 to 8 reading blocks (plus one collapsed Meta appendix); visible prose cut from v1's 2,649 words / 903 in paragraphs to roughly 1,156 visible words (details.note/meta content excluded, per the brief's own two-level disclosure rule); the 56 footnote markers become 6 inline audit disclosures (<details class="note">) at point of use, native HTML with no script, forced open under @media print so nothing is truly hidden. 5) Exactly one hero figure at the type system's display size (6/14); five secondary KPIs and all section heads share one smaller size; four sizes and two weights total, replacing v1's six-ish sizes with no single winner.
notes.interaction_boundary_held: Every details.note/meta element discloses EVIDENCE OR ELABORATION only — a citation, a caveat, a longer explanation. None hides or reveals a DATA VALUE: the 8 blanks, the F-01 stated/recounted numbers, the 3 unsettled designated tests and the load-bearing row's Yes/No/Unknown split are all in the static flow, unclicked. No sort, filter or show/hide control exists; the two sort orders on the page (the fourteen, ART-011's own order; the cluster gap chart, worst-first) are stated in prose as editorial choices, not controls.
